name: Pudding
source: Pudding is a 1st year student at the school the protagonist is a nurse at.  When the protagonist meets her, her name is Pudding, when she 'evolves' near the end of the game her name is Pudding a la Mode.  She always wants to help Icecream whom she calls 'Onee-chan'.  Her hobby is supporting Icecream.  She hates being alone.  Her dream is to become the student president of the school.
translation: Pudding is a 1st year student at the school the protagonist is a nurse at. Her hobby is supporting Icecream.  She hates being alone.  Her dream is to become the student president of the school.
